title: Inzamam 1992: semi-final ka jawan toofan 🔥 #shorts
facebook_title: Inzamam 1992: the young storm in the semi-final
caption:
Raat bhar bukhar… aur agle din World Cup semi-final! 🔥

21 March 1992, Auckland: 22 saal ke Inzamam-ul-Haq ne 37 gendon mein 60 run thok diye. Pakistan ne 263 ka target hasil kiya, pehli baar World Cup final mein pahuncha — aur phir champion bana.

Inzamam ki sabse yaadgaar paari kaun si hai? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
